toolkit.changeCase.includeDotInCurrentWo.description: Include dots in word boundary detection when no text is selected.

toolkit.autoRenameTag.activationOnLangua.description: Languages for which auto rename tag is active. Use ["*"] for all.

toolkit.openInGitHub.remoteName.description: Name of the git remote to use.

toolkit.openInGitHub.defaultBranch.description: Fallback branch name when current branch cannot be determined.

toolkit.openInGitHub.useCurrentBranch.description: Use current local branch instead of the default branch.

toolkit.openInGitHub.useLocalLine.description: Include line number/range in GitHub URL.

toolkit.formatFiles.includeGlob.description: Glob pattern for files to format.

toolkit.formatFiles.runOrganizeImports.description: Run Organize Imports before formatting each file.

toolkit.formatFiles.useGitIgnore.description: Skip files that are ignored by .gitignore (uses `git check-ignore` under the hood). Falls back gracefully when the workspace is not a git repository.

toolkit.expandRecursively.excludePattern.description: Folder names to exclude when expanding recursively.

toolkit.slug.decamelize.description: Split camelCase words when generating slugs.

name.description: Display name for this package source.

toolkit.nuget.sources.description: NuGet package sources. Each source needs a name and a V3 service index URL.

toolkit.nuget.requestTimeout.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for NuGet API calls.

toolkit.nuget.defaultPrerelease.description: Include prerelease packages by default when browsing.

name.description: Display name for this package source.

toolkit.npm.sources.description: npm package sources. Each source needs a name and a registry URL.

toolkit.npm.requestTimeout.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for npm registry API calls.

toolkit.npm.defaultPrerelease.description: Include prerelease packages by default when browsing.

toolkit.csharp.useFileScopedNamespace.description: Use file-scoped namespaces in generated C# files (.NET 6+).

toolkit.csharp.includeUsings.description: Include default using statements in generated C# files.

toolkit.csharp.filterImplicitUsings.description: Filter out implicit usings from generated files (.NET 6+ with ImplicitUsings enabled).

toolkit.csharp.useThisForCtorAssignments.description: Use 'this.' prefix in generated constructor property assignments.

toolkit.csharp.privateMemberPrefix.description: Prefix for private members in generated constructors (e.g., '_').

toolkit.npmIntellisense.languages.description: Languages for which npm intellisense is active. Requires reload after change.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.recursivePackage.description: Look for package.json in the nearest parent directory instead of workspace root.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.packageSubfolder.description: (Experimental) Enable path completions for subfolders of npm packages.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.showBuiltinModul.description: Include built-in Node.js modules (fs, path, etc.) in completions.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.excludePackages.description: Package names to exclude from completions.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.importES6.description: Use ES6 import syntax instead of require() for the import command.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.importQuotes.description: Quote style for the import command.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.importLinebreak.description: Line ending appended after the import statement.

toolkit.npmIntellisense.importDeclaratio.description: Declaration type for require() imports (const, let, var).

toolkit.pdfViewer.scale.description: Default zoom level when opening PDF files. You can also use a numeric value (e.g. "1.5" for 150%).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.enabled.description: Enable enhanced visibility for diagnostics (hints, info, warnings).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.highlightHin.description: Highlight Hint-level diagnostics (the nearly invisible three dots).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.highlightWar.description: Highlight Warning-level diagnostics (already visible by default in VS Code).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.hintColor.description: Color for Hint diagnostics (underline + background tint).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.infoColor.description: Color for Information diagnostics (underline + background tint).

toolkit.diagnosticHighlight.warningColor.description: Color for Warning diagnostics (underline + background tint).

toolkit.typeOnlyImports.enabled.description: Enable detection of imports that are only used as types (`import` → `import type`).

toolkit.typeOnlyImports.severity.description: Severity of the diagnostic surfaced when an import can be converted to `import type`.

toolkit.csvRainbow.enabled.description: Enable rainbow column colors in .csv and .tsv files.

toolkit.csvRainbow.colors.description: Color palette used to colorize CSV columns in rotation.

toolkit.csvRainbow.delimiters.description: Candidate delimiters used to auto-detect the CSV separator. TSV files always use tab.

toolkit.csvRainbow.maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to colorize. Lines beyond this limit are skipped to keep performance predictable on huge files.

toolkit.lines.naturalSort.description: Use natural sort (so 'item2' comes before 'item10') when sorting alphabetically.

toolkit.lines.dedupeKeepLast.description: When removing duplicate lines, keep the last occurrence instead of the first.

toolkit.align.spacesBefore.description: Number of spaces inserted between the (trimmed) prefix and the alignment delimiter, with optional per-delimiter overrides. The 'default' key applies when no specific override matches.

toolkit.align.spacesAfter.description: Number of spaces inserted between the alignment delimiter and the (trimmed) suffix, with optional per-delimiter overrides. Ignored on lines where the suffix is empty.

toolkit.insert.randomHexBytes.description: Default number of random bytes for 'Toolkit: Insert Random Hex...' (the output is 2× this many hex characters).

toolkit.insert.randomBase64Bytes.description: Default number of random bytes for 'Toolkit: Insert Random Base64...' (the output is URL-safe Base64 without padding).

toolkit.insert.uuidUppercase.description: Output UUIDs (v4 and v7) in uppercase. ULID is always uppercase per its specification.

toolkit.timestamp.hover.enabled.description: Show a hover with the decoded date when hovering 10/13/16-digit numbers that look like Unix timestamps.

toolkit.timestamp.hover.languages.description: Languages for which the timestamp hover is active. Requires reload after change. Use ["*"] for all languages.

toolkit.timestamp.hover.minYear.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for considering a number to be a timestamp.

toolkit.timestamp.hover.maxYear.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for considering a number to be a timestamp.

toolkit.uuidHover.enabled.description: Show a hover with the kind and embedded creation time when hovering UUIDs and ULIDs.

toolkit.uuidHover.languages.description: Languages for which the UUID/ULID hover is active. Requires reload after change. Use ["*"] for all languages.

toolkit.envCheck.enabled.description: Compare .env files with their committed example (.env.example, .env.sample, ...) and surface missing/undeclared keys as diagnostics.

toolkit.envCheck.exampleNames.description: File names recognized as the committed example, in lookup order.

toolkit.envCheck.severity.description: Severity of the missing-keys diagnostic. Undeclared keys are always reported as hints.

toolkit.jsonToType.extractNestedTypes.description: Emit a named type for each nested object instead of inlining anonymous shapes.

toolkit.jsonToType.typescript.semicolons.description: Terminate each TypeScript field with a semicolon.

toolkit.jsonToType.csharp.collectionType.description: Collection wrapper used for JSON arrays in C# output.

toolkit.jsonToType.csharp.recordStyle.description: Generated C# record style. Positional: 'public record X(int Id, string Name)'. With properties: declared bodies with init-only properties.

toolkit.jsonToType.csharp.useNullable.description: Mark optional or nullable fields with '?' (assumes a nullable context for reference types).

toolkit.pasteImage.directory.description: Folder where pasted images are saved. Relative to the file or the workspace (see toolkit.pasteImage.basePath). Absolute paths are honored as-is.

toolkit.pasteImage.basePath.description: Anchor for the image directory: relative to the current file or to the workspace root.

toolkit.pasteImage.naming.description: How to name pasted images. 'timestamp' uses the configured timestamp format; 'prompt' asks every time.

toolkit.pasteImage.timestampFormat.description: Token-based timestamp format. Supported tokens: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss.

toolkit.pasteImage.format.description: Link format used when inserting the image. 'auto' picks Markdown for .md and HTML for .html/.razor/.cshtml.

toolkit.pasteImage.useForwardSlashes.description: Force forward slashes in the inserted relative path (cleaner for cross-platform repos).

toolkit.pasteImage.htmlAttributes.description: Extra attributes appended to the inserted tag (e.g. class="screenshot").

toolkit.clipboardHistory.enabled.description: Track changes to the clipboard while VS Code is focused so they can be recalled with 'Toolkit: Show Clipboard History'.

toolkit.clipboardHistory.maxItems.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the in-memory clipboard history (FIFO when the limit is reached).

toolkit.clipboardHistory.maxItemLength.description: Maximum character length of a single entry. Larger clipboard contents are skipped.

toolkit.clipboardHistory.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) the clipboard is polled for changes while VS Code is focused.

toolkit.bookmarks.gutterIcon.description: Show a bookmark icon in the gutter on bookmarked lines.

toolkit.bookmarks.highlightLine.description: Highlight the full line of every bookmark with a subtle background color.

toolkit.bookmarks.highlightColor.description: Background color used when 'highlightLine' is enabled. Accepts any CSS color.

toolkit.todoTree.tags.description: Comment tags collected by the TODO Tree.

toolkit.todoTree.includeGlob.description: Glob pattern for files to scan.

toolkit.todoTree.excludedFolders.description: Base folders to skip when scanning. Each entry can be: a bare folder name matched at any depth (e.g. `node_modules`), a workspace-relative path (e.g. `src/vendor/lib-x`), or a glob (e.g. `packages/*/dist`). Folders excluded interactively via the "Exclude Folder…" command are stored per-workspace in VS Code's local storage (not in `.vscode/settings.json`), so they are never committed; the effective exclusion list is the union of this setting and those personal exclusions.

toolkit.todoTree.groupBy.description: Default grouping of the TODO Tree view. Toggling the grouping from the view is remembered per-workspace in VS Code's local storage and takes precedence over this setting.

toolkit.todoTree.maxFiles.description: Hard cap on the number of files scanned.

toolkit.todoTree.useGitIgnore.description: Skip files that are ignored by .gitignore (uses `git check-ignore` under the hood). Falls back gracefully when the workspace is not a git repository.

toolkit.restClient.timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. 0 disables the timeout.

toolkit.restClient.previewResponseAs.description: Editor language used to render the response when shown as text. 'auto' picks one from the Content-Type.

enumDescriptions: Show the full response as text in a reused editor (native highlighting and find).
Show the response in the rich detail panel (status, headers, body).
toolkit.restClient.previewResponseIn.description: Where a freshly-sent request (Send Request) shows its response.

toolkit.restClient.historySize.description: How many recent responses to keep in the per-workspace history (0 disables history).

toolkit.restClient.history.storeRequest.description: Store the resolved request (method, URL, headers and body) alongside each response so it can be re-sent and copied as curl. Disable to avoid persisting request headers such as Authorization in the workspace storage — re-send then falls back to re-running the request from its source .http file.

enumDescriptions: Open the response as text in a reused preview editor.
Open the response in the rich detail panel (status, headers, body).
toolkit.restClient.history.clickAction.description: What selecting a response (from the Response History view or the picker) does.

toolkit.peekCommit.hover.enabled.description: Show a hover with the last commit that touched the line under the cursor.

toolkit.peekCommit.hover.languages.description: Languages where the peek-commit hover is active. Reload required after change.

toolkit.toggleQuotes.languageQuotes.description: Allowed quote characters per language id. Used to cycle 'Toolkit: Toggle Quotes' through only the quotes that are valid for the current language. The 'default' key is used when the current language id is not listed.
